notes.title: Lust from Beyond: M Edition Demo available now and game release date
notes.notes:
Hello Cultists! 

Today is a big day – the demo for our survival horror, Lust from Beyond: M Edition, is now available on Steam! What’s more, the full version of the game will be released on the 10th of February 2022, priced at $17.99 with a 10% launch discount.

Watch the trailer here below:
[previewyoutube=NBSNPvt-vJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Play the demo now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1641890/Lust_from_Beyond_M_Edition/

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey Cultists!

I’m Michał, the game director and producer of Lust from Beyond. We decided [b]to move the release date to March 11th[/b], and I’d like you to know why. 

The game’s complete, but our beta tests showed that we can further optimize the code and environment. We think that if we can make it better, we should. We’ll make LfB look and run smoother on older hardware. 

But even today, we’re proud of what we have! 

We’re a small studio, and we’re combining different aspects of horror. We’re making a game that’s longer than Lust for Darkness and the two LfB prologues combined. We have choices, and even elements of RPG-like character development. The prologues had a Steam rating of 88% and 82%. We aim at least this high, and with a way larger game this time.

I’ll see you in the Land of Ecstasy on March 11th. And we'll have some pleasant surprises along the way. Thanks for being with us.

Yv'h lauv'abrarc, Yv'h Lusst'ghaa!

Michał Ciastoń,
Game Director & Producer

notes.title: An Update for "Lust from Beyond" Release Date
notes.notes:
Beloved Cultists!

We would like to bring Lust from Beyond to your houses as soon as possible, but also give you the best experience. This is not an easy task but we try our best every day to make that happen. For this reason, we decided to give us additional time to polish the game and bring a truly immersive product that we all will be proud of and which will give you a lot of satisfaction.

[h3]Expect the game on February 25, 2021.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30060957/df571780337bb60f7b4cf6b7c5a362e8bb13e56c.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your patience and immeasurable support, for which we will be always thankful.

[i]Yv'h lauv'abrarc! Yv'h Lusst'ghaa![/i]

notes.title: Important Announcement About Scarlet's Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30060957/97f468f05e7ff89ae157de981c4f89a137143fcc.jpg[/img]

Dear Cultists,

Like you, we can’t wait for the premiere of Lust from Beyond: Scarlet. Just as with Lust from Beyond, we put all our hearts to this project to show you one more story before the launch of the full game.

We can confidently admit that the "Lust" series hits in slightly different subjects which can be considered by one audience as unique, or controversial by the second one. We're always caring to not cross this line too much, which requires thorough verification. It is always made not only by us, but also by Steam itself.

[b]Lust from Beyond: Scarlet is during its last verification by Steam workers.[/b] We’ve sent the game to review in time to finish any necessary procedures before October 1st. It seems that Lust from Beyond: Scarlet's final build is [b]surprisingly more strong and full of "various contents" than before for Steam.[/b] We’ve been so excited with a thought to show you something more from the "Lust" universe, but, unfortunately, Steam wants a [b]temporary exclusivity for that a bit longer.[/b]

But do not worry, we're not talking about some long terms! It is a matter of a[b] few days[/b] to finish it. [b]We'll launch "Scarlet" as fast as we get the accept.[/b] We'll inform you through [b]Steam, Facebook, and Twitter[/b] about Scarlet's availability.

Thank you for all your support and patience, and we hope that you will enjoy Lust for Beyond: Scarlet on its final release!

[i]Yv'h lauv'abrarc! Yv'h Lusst'ghaa![/i]

notes.title: Lust from Beyond: Scarlet - Release Date and news about Lust from Beyond
notes.notes:
Hello Cultists!

The second free prologue of the upcoming Lust from Beyond is closer than you think! We’re happy to announce that [b]Lust from Beyond: Scarlet[/b] will be available on [b]October 1st 2020! [/b]

[previewyoutube=sYirDT8Nj-4;full][/previewyoutube]

Alan's mind is possessed by a hardly satisfiable sexual drive. To control his emotions, Alan meets with a psychiatrist who is supposed to solve his problems. During the session, Alan talks about a strange date in an abandoned theatre. The story quickly turns into an experience filled with dread and dark desires…

Book the evening, put on your fanciest clothes and prepare for the date you’ll probably never forget!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1401680/Lust_from_Beyond_Scarlet/


[h2]We have also some important news about Lust from Beyond[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30060957/3824bcf1bfa514b6a78fbff0ecce54c8d9608f49.png[/img]

The release date, planned on 24th September has been postponed to the [b]fourth quarter of 2020[/b]. Our decision has been driven by willing to deliver you as pleasurable game as possible, so we will use this extra time to polish [b]Lust from Beyond[/b] even more.


Thank you for all your support during the game development so far. We hope that you’ll enjoy the story of Alan in [b]Lust from Beyond: Scarlet[/b]. Keep an eye on our future announcements!

Yv'h lauv'abrarc! Yv'h Lusst'ghaa!

notes.title: A new update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30060957/4cea6090b1933410266885c286854522b563dc04.png[/img]

Dear Cultists,

As promised, we continue working on updates for the game.

With update 1.2, we [b]fixed some glitches, solved the issue that our Korean players had with the game as well as added achievements[/b]. If you have already completed the game, you need to play through it again to get achievements. We tried to find a way to grant them to you post-factum but it wasn't doable. 

Please keep your suggestions coming, we appreciate your feedback a lot and want to keep improving the game together with you!

Finally, if you liked the game, please [b]leave us a review[/b] if you haven't done it yet following our previous request. It improves our visibility on Steam significantly and naturally we want as many people as possible to find out about Lust for Darkness. 

Y'vh Iauv'abrarc. Y'vh Lusst'ghaa. 
Willard Yelverton

notes.title: The first UPDATE and a big THANK YOU!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30060957/b579c997472f7c13e70bdc133d084edbef3e5c2f.png[/img]

Dear Cultists,

It's been only 2 days since we released Lust for Darkness and we are extremely humbled to see such a big interest in the game. It's also [b]wonderful to read your enthusiastic opinions[/b] about the game, it makes all of us really happy!

We are [b]a very small team of just 6 people[/b] and this is our [b]first game created together[/b]. It looks like all the effort we've put into it over the last year (and beyond) paid off.

We can't wait for more of you to play Lust for Darkness, and in the meantime we prepared a first update for the game featuring:
- improved collisions system
- fixed glitches
- fixed typos
- improved difficulty level in the Garden of Love

We are currently working on [b]another update[/b], including an option to change the controls as well as Steam achievements. If you have suggestions for what else we should add in the future updates, let us know!

Additionally, if you liked the game, [b]please leave us a review[/b]. It improves our visibility on Steam significantly and naturally we want as many people as possible to find out about Lust for Darkness. 

Finally, we love reading your feedback, whether positive or negative, so keep it coming! [b]Your voice is of the highest priority to us[/b], both in terms of improving Lust for Darkness further and developing our next games. 

Y'vh Iauv'abrarc. Y'vh Lusst'ghaa. 
Willard Yelverton
